findings.evidence: Identical `have : IsManifold I (1 + 1) M`, `have hV := ...`, `have hH := ...` lines open both private theorems; `have : IsManifold I (∞ + 1) M := by simpa using ...` is repeated in `contMDiff_oneillAux`, `contMDiff_oneillA` and `contMDiff_oneillT`.
findings.fix: Add one private lemma stating that both projection sections are MDifferentiableAt x, and one shared instance, and use them in all these proofs.
findings.issue: The same setup is copied verbatim into `oneillAux_apply` and `inner_oneillAux_add_inner`: the `IsManifold I (1 + 1) M` instance plus `hV`/`hH`, which state that both projections are differentiable at x (from `contMDiff_starProjection_ker`/`_orthogonal_ker` at `n := 1` with `.mdifferentiable`). The three smoothness theorems also each re-derive `IsManifold I (∞ + 1) M`. This hides a reusable fact.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Projection/Basic.lean:298 `lemma isIdempotentElem_starProjection : IsIdempotentElem K.starProjection`; the same argument appears in `oneillA_starProjection_orthogonal_ker`, `oneillA_starProjection_ker`, `oneillT_starProjection_ker`, `oneillT_starProjection_orthogonal_ker` and `oneillAux_apply`.
findings.fix: State one private @[simp] lemma for this idempotence, derived from Mathlib's `Submodule.isIdempotentElem_starProjection`, and use it in all five places.
findings.issue: The term `Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr (Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem (mfderiv I J f x).ker _)` is passed to `simp` five times: in all four projection simp lemmas and in `oneillAux_apply`. Each copy re-derives the same idempotence fact (projecting onto the kernel twice equals projecting once).

summary: Proofs are short and automation-based, but the same differentiability setup and the same idempotence term are copied across several proofs instead of being stated once as lemmas.
